  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

mjx-help > svg > circle {
  stroke-width: 1.5px;
  cx: 9px;
  cy: 9px;
  r: 9px;
  fill: white;
}

  fill: var(--mjx-bg1-color);
  r: 7px;
}

  stroke-width: 2.5px;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

mjx-help:hover > svg > circle:nth-child(2) {
  fill: white;
}

  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

  mjx-help > svg > circle {

  }
  mjx-help > svg > circle:nth-child(2) {
    fill: rgba(132, 132, 255, .3);
  }
  mjx-help:hover > svg > circle:nth-child(2) {
    stroke: #AAAAAA;
      fill: #404040;
  }
